# Local terminal player

asciinema-player 3.17.0, Apache-2.0.

Source: https://github.com/asciinema/asciinema-player/releases/tag/v3.17.0

The JavaScript and CSS are the unmodified release bundles. `asciinema-player.LICENSE` contains the upstream license. Keeping these assets local lets recordings play without a CDN request.
